clips.headline: Houston Texans Announce Global Headquarters
clips.caption: On February 12, 2026, the Houston Texans Announce Global Headquarters In Landmark Public-Private Partnership With Harris County and Howard Hughes Communities™ “Today is a historic day for the Houston Texans, our fans, and the Greater Houston area as we partner with Howard Hughes and Harris County on a world-class sports and entertainment destination, including our new headquarters and training facility,” said Cal McNair, Chair and Chief Executive Officer of the Houston Texans. “Our organization continues to grow and this aligns with our goals of bringing a championship to Houston, enhancing community services and making sports more accessible. This project reinforces our long-term commitment to Harris County and our focus on driving growth and opportunity for the community. It will set the new standard for the global sports and entertainment industry and it’s the most significant evolution for our organization since our inception.”

clips.headline: C.J. Stroud on PLAYOFF MINDSET after Chargers win 🏈
clips.caption: C.J. Stroud speaks with the media after the Houston Texans’ road win over the Los Angeles Chargers — the team’s eighth straight victory in a game that felt like a playoff test. Stroud breaks down what made the matchup challenging, how the Texans adjusted after halftime, and why “weathering the storm” is part of winning in December football. Stroud also gives major credit to the Texans defense for its relentless pressure on Justin Herbert, piling up sacks and creating a takeaway to swing momentum. With Houston continuing to build toward January, Stroud explains what makes this team equipped for a postseason run — pointing to the organizational foundation, physical style, and tough preparation led by Nick Casario and DeMeco Ryans. Plus, Stroud shares a brief “welcome home” moment in Southern California and shouts out his roots after a big Texans win in LA.
